posts.title: Building Frontrun with Claude Code
posts.description: This is a companion post to Announcing Frontrun, a concurrency testing library for Python. This post is about how I built it with Claude Code.

posts.title: Announcing Frontrun
posts.description: Frontrun is a Python library for deterministic concurrency testing: it reproduces race conditions by controlling thread interleavings, with trace markers, bytecode fuzzing, and DPOR.
